reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: forceLogoutAll has live non-test callers in route.ts:28 and SystemTab.tsx:34. Gate 2: attack vector is any authenticated Discord user via HTTP (untrusted); no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. Gate 3: src/app/api/force-logout-all is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/admin/force-logout-all with any valid oauth_user_id+oauth_access_token session cookie (middleware src/middleware.ts:38-40 checks cookie presence only, not admin role), causing forceLogoutAll() to bulk-insert 'out' records for every checked-in user and corrupt all active attendance sessions. Additionally, completeRegistration (actions.ts:233-238) fetches temp_registrations by caller-supplied qr_token via admin client without verifying the token was issued for the requesting user, enabling any authenticated user to claim an arbitrary unexpired QR token and link any physical NFC card to their own account (IDOR). Severity remains Critical: mass DoS on attendance data integrity + card impersonation, no deployment_context.client_diversity cap defined.
